edits.title: 首领战 · 删去 0:53 突兀高音（重画 0:52.83–0:53.64）
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) boss battle music for a video game. The melody rests here: no erhu, no dizi, no plucked strings, no high notes. Only the war drums keep a light steady pulse and the low strings hold a sustained drone underneath, leading into the next section. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.
